historical_coverage: the feed carries the last months of a committee's meetings; event pages persist by id back to 2013
publication_frequency: as hearings are noticed, statements a day before or the day of the hearing
reporting_lag: none for the statement; transcripts arrive months later on govinfo (CHRG)
access_restrictions: none; the feed links plain http and the redirect answers a shell, so the https form of the event page is requested
extraction_difficulty: low for the page (witness panels, document list); statements are native-text PDFs of 10 to 40 pages
answers: which Navy and Marine Corps leaders testified, when, before which subcommittee
what a witness statement names as priorities, programs and funding
which hearings named the department
cannot_answer: Senate hearings (armed-services.senate.gov and appropriations.senate.gov refuse this address; Browserbase)
proposed_monitor_frequency: weekly: the AS00 and AP00 feeds, new hearing pages naming the department, their statements

inspected_example.note: Department of the Navy FY2027 Budget Request for Seapower and Projection Forces, 2026-05-20; three witnesses; joint witness statement PDF

provider_name: Conference and event pages naming Navy officials, found by search discovery (Exa) and read from the organizer's or a trade outlet's page
responsible_org: the organizer of each event (Navy League, AFCEA, Potomac Officers Club, trade press); Exa is the finder only
fields_and_identifiers: named government speakers with rank and billet
historical_coverage: whatever Exa indexes; pages for a past event stay up for a year or two
publication_frequency: irregular; agendas firm up in the eight weeks before an event
reporting_lag: none for the organizer's page; trade coverage a day or two after
access_restrictions: third-party hosts; some refuse a plain request (429, 403) and come through Browserbase; Cloudflare challenge pages stay unread; Exa needs EXA_API_KEY
extraction_difficulty: moderate: page chrome and marketing around a few sentences that name the speakers
answers: which events a named official appears at, as the organizer states it
which capability themes an event names for the department
cannot_answer: what was said at the event (the speech archive, DVIDS or trade reporting)
proposed_monitor_frequency: monthly discovery query; the known pages re-fetched before each major event

inspected_example.note: Sea-Air-Space 2026 organizer page: CNO keynote at the Sea Services Luncheon; 15 pages discovered, 11 direct, 4 through Browserbase, 1 refused

provider_name: Trade and local news articles naming a Navy office, found by search discovery (Exa) and read from the outlet's page
responsible_org: the outlet that published each article (USNI News, Breaking Defense, Washington Times, local press, vendor releases); Exa is the finder only
fields_and_identifiers: contract numbers and values when quoted
historical_coverage: whatever Exa indexes; outlet archives stay up for years, paywalled pages read as a stub
publication_frequency: daily across outlets; a given office appears a few times a year
reporting_lag: same day to a week after the event reported
access_restrictions: third-party hosts; some refuse a plain request (403, 429) and come through Browserbase; paywalls and Cloudflare challenge pages stay unread; Exa needs EXA_API_KEY
extraction_difficulty: moderate: page chrome around a few paragraphs; the dateline is the event date only when the article says so
answers: what an outlet reported about an office on a date, as a dated claim with the quoted span
a leadership change or award the official record has not yet published
cannot_answer: anything not quoted from an official or a document (the claim stays the outlet's)
the official record itself (the release, the notice, the award)
proposed_monitor_frequency: weekly discovery query per watched office

inspected_example.note: trade article read directly; the news sweep files every discovered article under this source
